choices.text: "Stand down, guard. My name is Casimir Vael of Hollowmere..."

casimir_intro.speaker: Casimir
casimir_intro.text: Stand down, guard. My name is Casimir Vael of Hollowmere. I am an envoy from the Arcane University, bearing news for the king. My quest is of grave importance.

casimir_seal.speaker: Casimir
casimir_seal.action: Casimir holds up a letter sealed with the University's wax seal.
casimir_seal.text: Casimir Vael of Hollowmere, envoy of the Arcane University. I bear news for the king, and my quest is of grave importance.

guard_lets_pass.speaker: Guard
guard_lets_pass.text: An envoy with a message, you say? Then I won't delay you any further, m'lord. Go right ahead.

guard_shouts.speaker: Guard
guard_shouts.action: He turns and shouts up at the gatehouse.
